organism: Raw files were searched against uniprot human fasta database.
cell_types: Hep3B cells were stably transfected with shSRSF10 or shScramble followed by puromycin selection before SILAC.
cell_lines: Hep3B cells were stably transfected with shSRSF10 or shScramble followed by puromycin selection before SILAC.
scope: the stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) proteomic strategy was employed to reveal endogenous factors that interact with SRSF10 by IP using two commercial SRSF10 antibodies and mass spectrometry
Thirty mg of total lysates from heavy or light medium-labeled cells were pre-cleaned by 20¼l magnetic beads each for 1‱ h, followed by IP with 40¼l antibody-coated beads for 4‱ h at 4°C.

The IP eluate was separated by one-dimensional NuPAGE™ 4-15% Bis-Tris Protein Gel and stained with Colloidal Blue (Invitrogen). Protein bands were cut and digested with trypsin overnight. The samples were then analyzed with an Orbitrap Classic mass spectrometry

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed the SRSF10 interactome using SILAC and affinity purification (immunoprecipitation) from Hep3B cells.
